01 · Current release frame

One journey; no consumer test controls.

The founder-approved direction is a private trusted-tester beta. It keeps only the user-chosen-site journey and explicitly separates it from QA, legacy friction modes, experimental browse layers, and any autonomous Python or vision behaviour.

03 · Extraction order

Use this order to reduce the monolith without changing the product journey.

Extraction is a refactor only when state ownership, DOM IDs, timing, storage and acceptance path remain stable. Do not make visual components own checkout classification or merchant adapters.

01

Shared tokens and modal shell

Extract brand tokens, focus/reduced-motion rules and the cream `.ui-card-alt` shell first. It has no right to change hold, pass or timer state.

Visual regression
02

Observer and Product Pulse surfaces

Extract passive strip, soft prompt, active check and tether behind existing event handlers. Preserve current triggers and priority rechecks.

Cadence proof
03

Rationalisation shells

Move hold, Rationator, Deliberation, Urgente, cart-edit feedback and outcome cards into visual modules while leaving passes, cart verification and classification in runtime services.

Merchant proof
04

Onboarding and settings

Extract site selection and consent cards from current entrypoint. Keep WIP guided-demo files quarantined until explicitly approved for production onboarding.

Consent proof
05

Growth view components

Extract pure display components from the existing view models. Keep data selectors, QA provenance and optional delivery outside visual rendering.

Evidence-copy audit

04 · Export boundaries

These are dependencies, not UI components.

Daniella should keep these as explicit services/contracts. A component may receive their prepared state, but must not quietly recreate their authority.

Keep runtime-only

Generic decision logic, merchant uncertainty handling and bounded data contracts stay outside exported visual surfaces.

  • Checkout classification, `siteIdentityKey`, brand holds and checkout passes
  • `ProductExposureTracker`, cadence eligibility and async surface priority
  • `cart-snapshot.js`, native-cart adapters and verified-mutation checks
  • `background.js` hydration, alarms, tab cleanup and protected-site injection
  • Local storage/events, telemetry allow-list and consent gate

Do not export or ship

These may remain in the QA source as isolated test material, but are deliberately outside the user-facing handover.

  • QA speed-up button, test/production toggle, Ctrl+D preview and local tier override
  • Tests, reports, handovers, scripts and the Morrow guided-demo WIP
  • Retired friction modes, scroll stopper, blur/distortion, urgency/promo mute and legacy gates
  • Legacy escalation, add-to-cart and coupon overlays unless separately resurrected by a product decision
  • Python/vision/AI as a live prompt, hold or permission authority

05 · Proof and handoff gate

Static code is a map. It is not a shipped interaction.

The current audit supports the source map above. It does not prove onboarding rendering, merchant cart behaviour or `chrome-extension://` UI. Each component handoff carries its own acceptance path.

SurfaceStatic source statusBrowser proof still required
OnboardingCurrent card flow and local Top Sites boundary read in source.Explicit selection, opt-out, reset, production staging and extension-page rendering.
Observer + PulseCurrent timing, threshold, cooldown, priority and tether code read in source.Fresh interval, prompt hierarchy, dismissal cooldown, cart growth, placement and five-second deferral on merchant pages.
RationalisationCurrent runtime surfaces and visual shell identified.Checkout confidence, reload/subdomain, active-hold Rationator, Deliberation, verified cart edit and Urgente isolation.
GrowthPure view models and QA provenance paths exist.Popup/dashboard rendering, empty state, evidence labels, reset and offline/local behaviour.

Daniella’s component handoff rule

Every extracted component needs its source, owner, dependencies, deliberately excluded material, storage/event boundary, validation input and remaining risk recorded before the next contributor inherits it.

  1. Freeze the runtime contract first.
  2. Extract one owned visual surface.
  3. Prove browser behaviour separately.
